Hi, I'm Malu: a hybrid profile who brings together Digital Communication and Big Data & AI.

Originally from Cartagena (Murcia), I split my time between Murcia and Madrid. I'm a CEU San Pablo graduate: I first earned my Bachelor's Degree in Digital Communication there and then completed my Master's in Big Data & Artificial Intelligence.

I cover digital marketing end to end, from influencer management and content creation to in-depth metric analysis. I don't just post; I build strategy, connecting technical data with creative storytelling so every decision is backed by numbers and every campaign reaches people.

Until November 2026 I worked as Data Analyst & Head of Social Media at THEX, where I led content creation, community management and data-driven digital strategy, producing premium video with generative AI. I still manage the social media of Instituto Élan de Sexología, and I am available immediately for new roles and projects.

Beyond client work, I share practical AI tips on TikTok (@boleadelmar): the tools, prompts and workflows I use every day.

Featured project · Master's thesis Grade 9/10

Valoralia Systems

An Automated Valuation Model (AVM) for the Madrid housing market that combines classic tabular data with visual information extracted from listing photos using convolutional neural networks (ResNet50).

  • 7,968 real listings from Pisos.com
  • 42 zones across the Community of Madrid
  • 104,291 interior photos processed

The hybrid XGBoost model proves that adding 50 visual PCA components improves predictive power over a purely tabular model.

Creative AI & Generative Media

AI as a creative production layer — not a replacement for design thinking.

Due to confidentiality agreements (NDAs) with the companies and clients I work with, I cannot publicly show most of my enterprise-level AI projects. The selected experiments and personal workflows in this space follow the same methodology, prompt engineering and creative direction I apply in my daily professional practice.

Continuous AI Training

My AI practice is supported by structured training and continuous experimentation. I focus on understanding what each model does best, building repeatable workflows, improving prompts and combining generative tools with traditional design principles rather than relying on one-click outputs.
